title: Message another agent
description: Sends a message to another running agent.

title: Start another agent
description: Starts a sub-agent with its own task and tools.

title: Stop an agent
description: Stops a running agent.

title: Go back
description: Navigates back in history.

title: Clear cookies and storage
description: Deletes cookies, local storage and caches, signing out of sites.

title: Click an element
description: Clicks an element; a click may submit or purchase.

title: Download a file
description: Saves a file the page links to.

title: Run JavaScript in the page
description: Executes script in the page context.

title: Fill in a form
description: Sets the fields of a form.

title: Read cookies
description: Reads cookies, which may hold session credentials.

title: Answer a dialog
description: Accepts or dismisses a browser dialog.

title: Sign in to a site
description: Enters credentials and signs in.

title: Open a page
description: Loads a URL in the browser.

title: Press a key
description: Sends a key press to the page.

title: Save the page as PDF
description: Renders the page to a PDF file.

title: Read the page
description: Reads the text and structure of the current page.

title: Take a screenshot
description: Captures the current page as an image.

title: Scroll the page
description: Scrolls the page.

title: Choose an option
description: Selects an option of a drop-down.

title: Set a cookie
description: Writes a cookie.

title: Submit a form
description: Submits a form to the site, which may send data or trigger an action.

title: Close a tab
description: Closes a tab.

title: Open a tab
description: Opens a new tab.

title: Type text
description: Types text into the focused element.

title: Upload a file to a page
description: Sends a local file to a website.

title: Wait for an element
description: Waits until an element appears.

title: Read the clipboard
description: Reads clipboard text, which may hold anything the user copied.

title: Write to the clipboard
description: Replaces the clipboard content.

title: Click at a position
description: Moves the pointer and clicks.

title: Double-click at a position
description: Double-clicks, which opens or runs items.

title: Drag the pointer
description: Presses, moves and releases the pointer.

title: Press a key combination
description: Sends a key or shortcut to whatever has focus.

title: Move the pointer
description: Moves the pointer.

title: Capture the screen
description: Captures the screen, which may show private content.

title: Scroll
description: Scrolls at the pointer.

title: Type on the keyboard
description: Types text into whatever has focus.

title: Build an image
description: Builds an image from a build context; build steps run code.

title: Stop and remove a compose project
description: Stops and removes the services of a compose project.

title: Start a compose project
description: Starts every service of a compose file.

title: Run a command in a container
description: Executes a command inside a running container.

title: Read container logs
description: Reads the output of a container.

title: Prune unused containers and images
description: Deletes every unused container, image and network.

title: List containers
description: Lists containers.

title: Pull an image
description: Downloads an image from a registry.

title: Push an image to a registry
description: Uploads an image to a registry where others may pull it.

title: Remove a container
description: Deletes a container and optionally its volumes.

title: Run a container
description: Creates and starts a container from an image.

title: Stop a container
description: Stops a running container.

title: Read an environment variable
description: Reads one variable.

title: List environment variables
description: Lists variable names.

title: Set an environment variable
description: Sets a variable for later commands.

title: Append to a file
description: Appends text to the end of a file.

title: Create an archive
description: Packs paths into a zip or tar archive.

title: Change file permissions
description: Changes the mode bits of a path.

title: Change file owner
description: Changes the owner and group of a path.

title: Copy a file
description: Copies a file or directory to a new path.

title: Delete a file
description: Deletes a file permanently.

title: Delete a directory tree
description: Recursively deletes a directory and everything in it.

title: Extract an archive
description: Unpacks an archive into a directory, creating or replacing files.

title: Find files by pattern
description: Lists paths matching a glob.

title: List a directory
description: Lists the entries of a directory.

title: Create a directory
description: Creates a directory, including missing parents.

title: Move or rename a file
description: Moves a path; the source no longer exists afterwards and an existing target is replaced.

title: Read a file
description: Reads the contents of a file.

title: Read a binary file
description: Reads a file as bytes (base64).

title: Search file contents
description: Searches files under a path for a text pattern.

title: Securely erase a file
description: Overwrites and deletes a file so it cannot be recovered.

title: Read file metadata
description: Size, times and mode of a path.

title: Create a symbolic link
description: Creates a symlink at a path pointing at a target.

title: Create a temporary file
description: Creates an empty temporary file and returns its path.

title: Truncate a file
description: Cuts a file to a given length, discarding the rest.

title: Write or overwrite a file
description: Creates a file or replaces its contents.

title: Stage changes
description: Stages paths for the next commit.

title: Create a branch
description: Creates a branch.

title: Delete a branch
description: Deletes a local branch.

title: Switch branches or restore files
description: Switches the working tree to a revision; uncommitted changes to restored files are lost.

title: Delete untracked files
description: Removes every file not tracked by git.

title: Clone a repository
description: Downloads a repository and its history.

title: Create a commit
description: Records staged changes as a commit.

title: Read a diff
description: Differences between revisions or the working tree.

title: Read history
description: Commit history.

title: Merge a branch
description: Merges a revision into the current branch.

title: Pull from a remote
description: Fetches and merges remote changes.

title: Push to a remote
description: Publishes commits to a remote repository.

title: Force-push to a remote
description: Overwrites remote history with local history.

title: Rebase the current branch
description: Rewrites the current branch onto another base.

title: Discard all local changes
description: Resets the branch and working tree to a revision, losing uncommitted work.

title: Read repository status
description: Working tree status.

title: Push a tag
description: Publishes a tag, which often triggers a release.

title: HTTP DELETE
description: Deletes a remote resource.

title: Download a URL to a file
description: Fetches a URL and writes the response to disk.

title: HTTP GET
description: Fetches a URL.

title: GraphQL mutation
description: Runs a GraphQL mutation.

title: GraphQL query
description: Runs a read-only GraphQL query.

title: HTTP HEAD
description: Reads response headers of a URL.

title: Request an OAuth token
description: Exchanges client credentials or a code for an access token.

title: HTTP PATCH
description: Partially modifies a remote resource.

title: HTTP POST
description: Posts a body to a URL; the remote side may act on it.

title: HTTP PUT
description: Replaces a remote resource.

title: Send a webhook
description: Posts an event payload to a webhook URL outside the organisation.

title: Send over a WebSocket
description: Sends a message on a WebSocket connection.

title: Cancel a scheduled job
description: Removes a scheduled job.

title: List scheduled jobs
description: Lists scheduled jobs.

title: Schedule a recurring job
description: Creates a job that runs later or repeatedly.

title: Wait
description: Pauses for a number of seconds.

title: Call an MCP tool
description: Calls a tool on an MCP server whose effects are not described here; treated as running code.

title: Read system information
description: OS, hardware and uptime.

title: Lock the screen
description: Locks the session.

title: Show a notification
description: Shows a desktop notification.

title: Launch an application
description: Starts an installed application.

title: Open a URL in the default browser
description: Opens a link outside the agent browser.

title: Restart the machine
description: Restarts the computer, ending every session.

title: Set the system clock
description: Changes system time, which breaks certificates and logs.

title: Shut the machine down
description: Powers the computer off.

title: Delete a stored secret
description: Removes a secret from the local secret store.

title: Read a stored secret
description: Reads a secret from the local secret store.

title: Store a secret
description: Writes a secret to the local secret store.

title: Add a scheduled job
description: Adds a recurring command to the system scheduler.

title: Remove a scheduled job
description: Removes a recurring job from the system scheduler.

title: Install a software package
description: Installs a package with a package manager; install scripts run with the caller rights.

title: Kill a process
description: Terminates a process.

title: Read a process status
description: State, cpu and memory of one process.

title: List processes
description: Lists running processes.

title: Run a shell command
description: Runs a command line in a shell and returns its output.

title: Start a background process
description: Starts a long-running process and returns its pid.

title: Run a script
description: Runs source code with an interpreter.

title: Start, stop or restart a service
description: Controls a system service.

title: Run a command with elevated rights
description: Runs a command as root or another user.

title: Remove a software package
description: Removes an installed package.

title: Copy a file from a remote host
description: Downloads a remote file with scp or sftp.

title: Run a command on a remote host
description: Runs a command over SSH.

title: Open a network tunnel
description: Forwards a local port to a remote service through a host.

title: Copy a file to a remote host
description: Uploads a local file with scp or sftp, replacing the target.
